name: mtg-commander
description: EDHRec, Scryfall, MTG Rules, Archidekt, Moxfield, and collection support for Magic: The Gathering Commander/EDH.
long_description:
Local MCP server providing Magic: The Gathering Commander/EDH tooling: EDHRec recommendations, themes, combos, and commander browsing; Commander Spellbook combo search; bracket / Game Changers report on deck analysis and builds; Scryfall card lookup, search, and rulings; full 100-card deck building; Archidekt and Moxfield deck import and pricing; Delver Lens collection import and analysis; cross-deck card allocation; MTGJSON-backed local pricing cache; per-marketplace whole-deck buy lists; and a searchable MTG Comprehensive Rules index.

This package launches the existing Python MCP server in-place from /Users/williamtreadway/Documents/EDHrec-MCP using uv. It does not bundle Python or the project — the source repo and its .venv must remain at that path.

tools.name: edhrec_commander_recommendations
tools.description: Get recommended cards for a Commander deck from EDHRec.

tools.name: edhrec_commander_combos
tools.description: Get popular combos for a commander from EDHRec.

tools.name: spellbook_combos
tools.description: Search Commander Spellbook for combos by card names and/or color identity, most popular first.

tools.name: edhrec_commander_themes
tools.description: Get available themes/archetypes for a commander from EDHRec.

tools.name: edhrec_top_cards
tools.description: Get the top EDH cards by time period from EDHRec.

tools.name: edhrec_search_commanders
tools.description: Browse commanders by color identity from EDHRec.

tools.name: scryfall_card
tools.description: Look up a card on Scryfall. Returns full card data including oracle text, prices, EDHRec rank, and image URI.

tools.name: scryfall_search
tools.description: Search for cards using Scryfall search syntax.

tools.name: scryfall_rulings
tools.description: Get official rulings for a card from Scryfall.

tools.name: import_deck
tools.description: Import a deck from an Archidekt or Moxfield URL.

tools.name: analyze_deck
tools.description: Import and analyze a Commander deck from Archidekt or Moxfield.

tools.name: build_deck
tools.description: Build a full 100-card Commander deck.

tools.name: price_deck
tools.description: Price out a deck from Archidekt or Moxfield on TCGPlayer and Card Kingdom.

tools.name: import_collection
tools.description: Import a Magic collection from a Delver Lens CSV export.

tools.name: collection_summary
tools.description: Stats on the persisted active collection.

tools.name: compute_card_allocation
tools.description: Compute, across the active collection and the listed decks, how to allocate cards to a new deck.

tools.name: pull_and_buy_lists
tools.description: Cross-reference your collection, existing decks, and a new deck to produce a pull list and a per-marketplace buy list.

tools.name: refresh_pricing_data
tools.description: Refresh the local MTGJSON pricing cache.

tools.name: pricing_cache_status
tools.description: Inspect the local MTGJSON pricing cache without modifying it.

tools.name: mtg_rules
tools.description: Search the MTG Comprehensive Rules by keyword or rule number.
